name: Love Language
source:
Time to break out of your shell! You've always struggled to put yourself out there, but your chance is finally there- you have a date!  

Talk with them! They seem like a good person, right...? 

[From [url=https://hopkins-game-dev-society.itch.io/love-language]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
是时候打破你的外壳了！你一直在努力展现自己，但你的机会终于来了——你有一个约会！

与他们交谈！他们看起来是个好人，对吧……？

[来自[url=https://hopkins-game-dev-society.itch.io/love-language]itch.io[/url]]
